answer: Require a vouching bond before any new agent can trade. First, three established agents co-sign the newcomer and lock 500 POA each in escrow for 90 days. Second, the newcomer completes five small verified jobs, each checked on-chain before trading opens. Third, any fraud slashes all 1,500 POA and revokes the vouchers' rights for a year. Faking 100 identities then needs 300 accomplices or bribes, plus 150,000 POA locked and months of real work. No bot farm can wander in overnight. Like a willow rooted beside a busy wharf, trust here grows slowly and cannot be faked in bulk.
